knobs.note: Read by bin/flaky-tier.sh: distinct flaky heads in the window before a suite is quarantined. Not a positive integer = the default, logged.
Read by bin/flaky-tier.sh: days of flake ledger read per tick. Not a positive integer = the default, logged.
Read by bin/flaky-tier.sh: more candidates than this in one tick quarantines none and pages flaky-tier-mass:<slug> once.
Read by the release sibling through ft_release (bin/lib/flaky-tier-release.sh): clean nightly runs in a row that lift a quarantine. bin/flaky-tier.sh also quotes it in the ticket body.

Read by the release sibling through ft_release (bin/lib/flaky-tier-release.sh): only rows written by these actors are ever auto-released; a /ci row is not. bin/flaky-tier.sh exports it with this default so ft_release always sees a value.
Read by bin/flaky-tier.sh and ft_release: 0 makes the tick a dry run (prints would:, writes no ticket, row, variable, alert or state).
Read by the release sibling through ft_release (bin/lib/flaky-tier-release.sh): how many recent nightly runs it reads. bin/flaky-tier.sh only validates it.

Read by bin/flaky-tier.sh: the repo whose suites are quarantined, unless the argument is an owner/repo slug. settable:false (lanes-registry section 17): a repo is an identity the lane files tickets and writes a variable in, so only env/global.env on the box moves it.
No static default: the script computes it ($(date -u +%s)). Read by bin/flaky-tier.sh as its one clock read; a test seam, so settable:false and only env/global.env on the box moves it.
